$comment: A lobby teaser (Campaign.comingSoon), not the campaign: Riftlight is still in content/drafts/riftlight until family timing and route XP are accepted (its README). Every household's lobby shows this card beside Gemfall, locked with "Finish Gemfall first", then "Coming soon". It has no chapters and nothing can start it. Publishing Riftlight replaces this file under the same id, keeping `listed` and `requires`, so the card and its art (assets/campaigns/riftlight.webp) carry straight over.
title: Riftlight
blurb: Snow falls on the Exchange quay. A small goat needs help. Beyond a fold in the air, a bell is ringing in the ice.
